description: FREE (key) — change cells of a list shared with you for editing: per record (`records: [{ id, column: value }]`) or one change for many (`record_ids` or `filter` + `set`). Only the columns you may write (describe_list); `only_empty` fills empty cells only.

filter.description: Column → value: exact, { "contains": "…" }, { "not": "…" }, { "is_empty": true } or { "condition": "<one of filter_conditions>" }; ar_status by status name

list_id.description: The list's id (describe_list without list_id shows the lists shared with you)

set.description: With record_ids or filter: column → new value

name: update_records
title: Update records
